title: Randomized Momentum Transport with Cheap Predictors
abstract: arXiv:2610.13789v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Momentum methods such as STORM and second-order momentum track the gradient by adding a transport correction to momentum, at the cost of an extra oracle call per iteration. We introduce randomized momentum transport, which evaluates the correction with probability $q$ and otherwise uses a cheap prediction, with importance weighting that preserves the conditional mean and adds $(q^{-1}-1)$ times the prediction loss to the variance. Under transport-bias, second-moment, and residual-control assumptions, linear minimization oracle (LMO) updates, including normalized, sign, and exact spectral (Muon) directions, retain an $O(T^{-1/3})$ stationarity bound for each fixed $q>0$ with a single-gradient initialization. For unnormalized STORM, some $q<1$ lowers the leading coefficient of our sufficient gradient budget if and only if the gradient-difference noise modulus exceeds the smoothness constant, by at most about $10\%$. translated_title: 带廉价预测器的随机动量传输
translated_abstract: 诸如STORM和二阶动量等动量方法通过在动量上添加传输校正来跟踪梯度，但其代价是每次迭代需要一次额外的oracle调用。我们引入了随机动量传输方法，该方法以概率 $q$ 计算校正项，否则使用廉价的预测，并通过重要性加权保持条件均值，同时将 $(q^{-1}-1)$ 倍的预测损失加到方差上。在传输偏差、二阶矩和残差控制假设下，线性最小化oracle（LMO）更新——包括归一化方向、符号方向和精确谱方向（Muon）——在单梯度初始化下，对于每个固定的 $q>0$ 都能保持 $O(T^{-1/3})$ 的平稳性界。对于未归一化的STORM，当且仅当梯度差噪声模量超过光滑度常数时，某个 $q<1$ 才能降低充分梯度预算的首项系数，降幅最多约 $10\%$。在线对角预…（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出随机动量传输方法，以概率 $q$ 执行昂贵的传输校正、其余时候使用廉价预测并配合重要性加权，在保持 $O(T^{-1/3})$ 平稳性收敛界的同时显著降低了动量方法的oracle调用成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes randomized momentum transport, which evaluates the expensive transport correction with probability $q$ and otherwise uses cheap predictions with importance weighting, preserving the $O(T^{-1/3})$ stationarity bound while significantly reducing oracle calls in momentum methods.
